# Alisa Tech Studio - Complete Knowledge & System Documentation (llms-full.txt)

> Alisa Tech Studio is an independent mobile application and modern web software development studio specializing in high-performance Flutter mobile applications, cognitive puzzle gaming, and educational language learning software.

---

## 1. Company & Entity Overview
- **Legal Entity**: Alisa Tech Studio
- **Official Website**: https://alisatechstudio.online/

- **Contact Email**: alisatechstudio@gmail.com
- **Google Play Developer**: Alisa Tech Studio
- **Core Technology Stack**: Flutter (Dart), Firebase, Cloudflare, Node.js, Web Standards (HTML5/CSS3/ESNext), REST APIs
- **Specialization**: 120 FPS buttery rendering pipelines, isolated thread concurrency, on-device SQLite caching, zero-jank cross-platform compilation for Android and iOS.

## 2. Core Applications & Products

### German & Italian Language Mastery Series (A1 & A2)
- **Target Audience**: Polyglots, travelers, language students, CEFR A1-A2 learners.
- **Apps**: Learn German A1 (`com.alisatechstudio.german_a1`), Learn German A2 (`com.alisatechstudio.german_a2`), Learn Italian A1 (`com.alisatechstudio.italian_a1`), Learn Italian A2 (`com.alisatechstudio.italian_a2`).
- **Methodology**: Dual-language comparative acquisition utilizing Leitner Spaced Repetition (SRS), native pronunciation audio playback, contextual grammatical breakdowns, and offline vocabulary mastery.
- **Platforms**: Android (Google Play) and iOS.

### MindSharp Sudoku Pro & Puzzle Collection
- **Apps**: Sudoku Classic (`com.alisatechstudio.sudoku`), Math Puzzles (`com.alisatechstudio.math_puzzle`), Color Sort (`com.alisatechstudio.color_sort`), Arrow Escape (`com.alisatechstudio.arrow_escape`), Fruit Crush Saga (`com.alisatechstudio.fruit_crush_saga`), Lodu Boss (`com.alisatecstudio.lodu_boss`).
- **Features**: Procedurally generated deterministic puzzles across 5 distinct difficulty tiers, smart deduction hints, and offline capabilities.

### Utility & Productivity Apps
- **Apps**: Alisa VPN (`com.alisatechstudio.alisa_vpn`), News All in One (`com.alisatechstudio.news_all_in_one`), Personal Finance Tracker (`com.alisatechstudio.personal_finance_tracker`), QR & Barcode Scanner (`com.alisatechstudio.qr_scanner`), To Buy Shopping List (`com.alisatechstudio.to_buy`), Talk Messenger (`com.alisatechstudio.talk`), Bangladesh Constitution (`com.alisatechstudio.bangladesh_constitution`).

### BMCAG Report
- **Package ID**: `org.bmcag.reports`
- **Category**: Productivity & Community Reporting
- **Target Audience**: Members and organizers of the Bangladeshi Muslim Community Association Germany (BMCAG).
- **Core Functionality**: Personal development monitoring, daily and monthly activity logging, structured progress tracking, and organization communication.
- **Platforms**: Android (Google Play Store).

### Web Applications & Digital Platforms
- **Alisa Movies** (`https://alisastream.site`): 4K Ultra-HD bufferless streaming media portal.
- **Exam Results BD** (`https://examresultsbd.online`): National Bangladesh examination marksheet and result portal.
- **Live Sports TV Portal** (`https://livesportstv.store`): Real-time sports fixture and live event broadcast directory.
- **World Stock News** (`https://worldstocknews.online`): Real-time equity market data, economic calendars, and financial news intelligence.
- **Alisa Fashion Store** (`https://alisa-fashion.shop`): Boutique apparel e-commerce portal with mobile-first checkout.
- **All Calculation Hub**: Multi-utility computational web tools for finance, math, and conversions.
- **Alisa CRM Suite**: Full-stack MERN (React/Node/MongoDB) enterprise pipeline and customer relationship management platform.
- **BD News Portal**: Bilingual district-level news publishing system with live RSS syndication.
- **BMCAG Community Portal** (`https://bmcag.org`): Official German-Bangladeshi community non-profit portal.

### Custom Software Engineering
- **Services**: Turnkey mobile app architecture, Flutter migration from native codebases, API design, App Store & Google Play submission and compliance management, GDPR & ATT privacy architecture.

## 3. Engineering & Technical Publications

### Flutter Mobile App Performance Optimization (120 FPS Blueprint)
- **Key Takeaways**:
  1. Constraining widget rebuilding through granular `ValueListenableBuilder`, `BlocSelector`, or `Riverpod` selective listeners.
  2. Offloading CPU-heavy computational tasks (JSON serialization, matrix calculations) into background Dart `Isolates`.
  3. Eliminating shader compilation stutter using Impeller graphics runtime on iOS and Vulkan on Android.
  4. Memory leak profiling via Flutter DevTools Allocation Tracker to avoid retained closures in widget trees.

### Advanced Sudoku Cognitive Strategies
- **Techniques Explained**:
  1. **Naked Singles & Hidden Singles**: Basic elimination in rows, columns, and 3x3 blocks.
  2. **Locked Candidates (Pointing & Claiming)**: Restricting candidate positions to eliminate possibilities in intersecting units.
  3. **X-Wing & Swordfish Patterns**: Advanced 2-row / 3-row grid candidate parity deductions.

### Accelerated Dual-Language Acquisition Framework
- **Key Principles**:
  1. Comprehensible Input hypothesis (Stephen Krashen) adapted for bilingual comparison.
  2. Spaced Repetition intervals optimized for long-term retention.
  3. Active recall testing with phonetic feedback.

### Mobile App Privacy & Cryptographic Security
- **Best Practices**:
  1. Android Privacy Sandbox & iOS App Tracking Transparency (ATT) integration.
  2. On-device encrypted KeyStore / Keychain credentials.
  3. Google Consent Mode v2 implementation with granular consent categories.

---

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What does Alisa Tech Studio do?
Alisa Tech Studio develops native-grade mobile applications using Flutter and Dart, focused on cognitive training tools, educational applications, and privacy-first digital experiences.

### Are Alisa Tech Studio applications available offline?
Yes, all core applications—including MindSharp Sudoku and language learning flashcards—are built with local SQLite persistence and function 100% offline without requiring continuous internet access.

### How can I contact Alisa Tech Studio for business or support?
You can reach our engineering and support team directly via email at alisatechstudio@gmail.com or via the contact form on https://alisatechstudio.online/contact.html.
